entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver golem planeswalker immune to Phyrexian influence who gives each companion a false location for the sylex to find a spy.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A fire-wielding planeswalker whose flames sterilize Phyrexian creatures and who rescues Jodah and Teferi.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: An ancient planeswalker who builds locators for the Phyrexian creature and is exhausted from portaling.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who was Urza's student, is gravely wounded by Phyrexian creatures, and helps Karn guard the sylex.

entities.name: Stenn
entities.description: A New Argive nobleman who turns out to be a compleated Phyrexian sleeper agent that transmits the sylex's false location to Sheoldred.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker whose amulet is the only reason the Weatherlight picks up Karn's call; he is seen fighting elsewhere.

entities.name: Shanna
entities.description: The captain of the Weatherlight, who answers Karn's call.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor to whom Stenn transmits a false sylex location.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Karn's creator, who used him like a tool; Teferi was his student.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: Karn's friend, who was once romantically involved with Jodah.

entities.name: Niambi
entities.description: Teferi's daughter, who got him thinking about how Urza used Karn.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: A lost friend whose spark protects Karn.

entities.name: Phyrexian spy-creature
entities.description: A shape-shifting creature that splits into many pieces and infests New Argive's watchtower.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders who have infiltrated Dominaria's governments and infested the watchtower.

entities.name: Sylex
entities.description: A Thran device that Karn plans to bring to New Phyrexia and whose location he keeps secret.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: An airship captained by Shanna that Karn summons to rescue the group.

entities.name: Powerstone
entities.description: The Thran powerstone that powers the watchtower and that Stenn uses to broadcast.

entities.name: New Argive's watchtower
entities.description: A tower in New Argive in lockdown, infested by Phyrexian creatures.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: The nation whose watchtower the group is in.

entities.name: Tolaria West
entities.description: A place with sea caves, named by Karn as a false hiding place for the sylex.

entities.name: Estark
entities.description: The location of a warehouse named by Karn as a false hiding place for the sylex.

entities.name: Suq'Ata
entities.description: A place named by Karn as a false hiding place for the sylex.

entities.name: Trokair
entities.description: Ruins on Sarpadia named by Karn as a false hiding place for the sylex.

events.summary: Locked in the watchtower, Karn refuses to reveal the sylex's location or his plan until the group captures the Phyrexian spy and is sure of its members.
events.quote: "I have a plan to find and defeat Sheoldred," Karn said.

events.summary: The group splits up to search the tower, Karn and Teferi taking the lower floors and Stenn the basement.
events.quote: "Jaya and I can take the upper floors," Jodah said.

events.summary: Karn and Teferi find signs of the creature in the storage room and overhear Jodah and Jaya arguing through a vent.
events.quote: A throbbing chunk of meat had attached itself, barnacle-like, to the copper.

events.summary: Teferi apologizes to Karn for how Urza treated him; Karn tells Teferi he hid the sylex in a sea cave by Tolaria West.
events.quote: I have hidden it in a sea cave by Tolaria West.

events.summary: Jodah and Jaya fight the squid-like Phyrexian, which splits into pieces and escapes through the stone.
events.quote: The creature split again, this time into four small chittering beasts

events.summary: Jodah makes locators from samples of the Phyrexian flesh, and Karn watches Ajani in a scryer.
Karn tells Jodah the sylex is in a warehouse in Estark; the locators then point in every direction as creatures swarm Karn and Jodah.
events.quote: Creatures flung themselves at Karn and Jodah, cables outstretched and mouths seeking.

events.summary: Jaya saves Jodah and Karn with a blast of fire, which seems to sterilize the creatures.
Karn tells Jaya the sylex is hidden in Suq'Ata.
events.quote: "Yes," Karn said. "It is hidden in Suq'Ata."

events.summary: Karn and Jaya find Teferi pinned and gutted by a Phyrexian monstrosity; Karn kills it and Jaya burns dozens more.
events.quote: They found Teferi pinned to floor by a Phyrexian monstrosity

events.summary: The group goes to the powerstone chamber, where Karn tells Stenn the sylex is in the ruins of Trokair on Sarpadia.
events.quote: "I concealed it in the ruins of Trokair, on Sarpadia."

events.summary: Stenn is revealed as a Phyrexian sleeper agent who transforms himself into an antenna and transmits the false location to Sheoldred.
events.quote: He had converted his entire body into an antenna, Karn realized

events.summary: Stenn's cables ensnare Jaya, and Karn dismembers him as Jaya burns him; the tower's lockdown is lifted.
events.quote: He dismembered Stenn—no, not Stenn, the Phyrexian who had killed Stenn

events.summary: Karn calls the Weatherlight with the amulet and Shanna promises to come, while the group braces for the Phyrexians closing in.

relations.note: A compleated sleeper agent who transmits the sylex location.
relations.quote: transmitted his hard-won knowledge to Sheoldred

relations.note: Karn dismembers the Phyrexian who replaced Stenn.
relations.quote: He dismembered Stenn—no, not Stenn, the Phyrexian who had killed Stenn

relations.note: Teferi defends Karn and offers to help guard the sylex.
relations.quote: "I honor your trust in me. I can help you guard it."
Teferi had been Urza's student before Karn's birth.

relations.note: They had a relationship that did not continue.
relations.quote: Jodah and Jhoira's relationship had not continued
Shanna's voice, quiet and tinny, piped up.

relations.note: Jaya burns the Phyrexian impostor wearing Stenn's body.
relations.quote: blasted not-Stenn with a gout of scarlet flame

relations.note: The powerstone is in the uppermost chamber.
relations.quote: In the uppermost chamber, the powerstone's glow dominated the claustrophobic space
